name: Shrimp Louie-Inspired Salad with Avocado, Cucumber & Tomato

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 0.68 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop shrimp.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until just cooked through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl along with ranch, ketchup, hot sauce, and spices. Stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup ranch dressing
3 tbsp ketchup
1 ½ tbsp hot sauce
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
When the shrimp are cool, add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
